scope: Observed native menu, Options, character selection, instructions, pause and post-round dialog; not complete original UI parity
evidencePolicy: Runtime existence, static asset binding and proposed reuse are separate claims. Names below are analyst component labels. Private inventory resolves opaque IDs to original resource details.

layoutContract.policy: Do not derive original logical coordinates by dividing the native screenshot. Reuse original scene geometry when available; overlay layout rules below are proposed constraints.
